---------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m5p5t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets, Sequences

CONSTANTS Cranes, Slots, Quorum

ASSUME Quorum \in Nat /\ Quorum >= 1

VARIABLES
    votes,      \* votes[s] = set of cranes that have voted to seal slot s
    open,       \* set of slots still open to voting
    sealed,     \* set of slots that have been irreversibly sealed
    congested,  \* set of cranes that are currently slow
    ledger      \* sequence of slots in the order they were sealed

vars == << votes, open, sealed, congested, ledger >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ votes \in [Slots -> SUBSET Cranes]
    /\ open \subseteq Slots
    /\ sealed \subseteq Slots
    /\ congested \subseteq Cranes
    /\ ledger \in Seq(Slots)

Init ==
    /\ votes = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ open = Slots
    /\ sealed = {}
    /\ congested = {}
    /\ ledger = << >>

\* A free (non-congested) crane casts a vote for an open slot it has not
\* yet voted for.
Vote(c, s) ==
    /\ c \notin congested
    /\ s \in open
    /\ c \notin votes[s]
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {c}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << open, sealed, congested, ledger >>

\* A crane becomes congested and stops casting new votes.
GoSlow(c) ==
    /\ c \notin congested
    /\ congested' = congested \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, open, sealed, ledger >>

\* A congested crane recovers and may vote again.
Resume(c) ==
    /\ c \in congested
    /\ congested' = congested \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, open, sealed, ledger >>

\* The controller seals an open slot that has reached quorum. The slot leaves
\* the open pool (making a second seal impossible) and is appended to the
\* ledger.
Seal(s) ==
    /\ s \in open
    /\ Cardinality(votes[s]) >= Quorum
    /\ open' = open \ {s}
    /\ sealed' = sealed \cup {s}
    /\ ledger' = Append(ledger, s)
    /\ UNCHANGED << votes, congested >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : Vote(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : GoSlow(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Resume(c)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Seal(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A slot is sealed only if a genuine quorum of distinct cranes voted for it.
QuorumBackedSeal ==
    \A s \in sealed : Cardinality(votes[s]) >= Quorum

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {c1, c2, c3}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    Quorum = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT QuorumBackedSeal
nl:
Scenario: a container-ship crane yard sealing stow-slots by quorum vote.

A row of gantry cranes works a container ship. Before a stow-slot (a fixed
position in the ship's cargo plan) can be declared final, the cranes hold a
quorum vote: each crane may cast at most one vote for a given slot. Sealing a
slot is irreversible -- once the yard controller seals a slot, that slot's
contents are welded down for the voyage and can never be reopened or re-sealed.

A crane may be SLOW: a slow crane is congested and temporarily cannot cast new
votes, but it has not failed and can resume at any time. Slowness only delays
voting; it never causes a vote to be lost or a seal to be undone.

The yard controller seals a slot only when the set of cranes that have voted for
that slot reaches the required quorum. Because a crane's vote is recorded once
and a sealed slot is removed from the pool of open slots, the irreversible
sealing of any one slot can happen at most once.

Actions: a free crane casts a vote for an open slot (Vote); a crane becomes
congested (GoSlow); a congested crane recovers (Resume); the controller seals a
slot that has reached quorum, removing it from the open pool and recording it in
the seal ledger (Seal).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every sealed stow-slot was backed by at least a quorum of
distinct crane votes at the moment it was sealed.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m0p3t5 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Flights, Slots

Free == "free"
Bump(v) == (v + 1) % 3

VARIABLES
    owner,      \* owner[s] = flight owning slot s, or Free
    ver,        \* ver[s] = optimistic-lock version of slot s (mod 3)
    claim,      \* claim[s] = set of flights with a live claim on slot s
    overrides   \* set of slots currently held via admin override

vars == << owner, ver, claim, overrides >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Slots -> Flights \cup {Free}]
    /\ ver \in [Slots -> 0..2]
    /\ claim \in [Slots -> SUBSET Flights]
    /\ overrides \subseteq Slots

Init ==
    /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> Free]
    /\ ver = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ claim = [s \in Slots |-> {}]
    /\ overrides = {}

\* A flight registers an optimistic claim on a slot it sees as free.
Claim(f, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = Free
    /\ f \notin claim[s]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {f}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << owner, ver, overrides >>

\* A claimant confirms and takes ownership. The version is bumped and every
\* live claim on the slot is cleared, forcing rivals to retry.
Confirm(f, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = Free
    /\ f \in claim[s]
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = f]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = Bump(@)]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ overrides' = overrides \ {s}

\* An owner releases its slot back to the free pool.
Release(f, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = f
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = Free]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = Bump(@)]
    /\ overrides' = overrides \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED claim

\* Privileged admin override: force-assign a free slot to a flight, clearing all
\* outstanding claims so none can later confirm on top of the assignment.
AdminOverride(f, s) ==
    /\ owner[s] = Free
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = f]
    /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![s] = Bump(@)]
    /\ claim' = [claim EXCEPT ![s] = {}]
    /\ overrides' = overrides \cup {s}

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Flights, s \in Slots : Claim(f, s)
    \/ \E f \in Flights, s \in Slots : Confirm(f, s)
    \/ \E f \in Flights, s \in Slots : Release(f, s)
    \/ \E f \in Flights, s \in Slots : AdminOverride(f, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* An owned slot admits no competing live claim, so it cannot be allocated twice.
NoRivalOnOwned ==
    \A s \in Slots : owner[s] # Free => claim[s] = {}

=============================================================================
nl:
Scenario: an air-traffic runway allocator using optimistic locking with retry.

An allocator hands out runway landing slots to inbound flights. Each slot carries
a version number. To claim a free slot a flight first registers an optimistic
claim; when it tries to confirm, it succeeds only if the slot is still free.
Confirming a slot bumps its version and clears every outstanding claim on that
slot, so competing flights whose claims lost must retry against the new version.

There is a privileged admin override: a controller can force-assign a free slot
directly to a flight, bypassing the claim/confirm handshake, but the override
still clears any outstanding claims so no stale claim can later confirm on top of
an assigned slot.

Because confirming or overriding a slot both mark it owned and clear all live
claims, a slot that already has a confirmed owner never carries a competing live
claim, so it can never be allocated to a second flight.

Actions: a flight registers an optimistic claim on a free slot (Claim); a
claiming flight confirms and takes ownership, bumping the version and clearing
rival claims (Confirm); an owner releases its slot back to free (Release); the
admin force-assigns a free slot to a flight and clears claims (AdminOverride).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a runway slot that already has a confirmed owner never
simultaneously carries an outstanding claim from another flight.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m2p6t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Firms, MaxEpoch

ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat /\ MaxEpoch >= 1

VARIABLES
    epoch,      \* current membership epoch
    members,    \* set of firms authorized to trade this epoch
    phase,      \* "voting", "committed", or "aborted"
    ballot,     \* ballot[f] \in {"none","yes","no"}
    stamp       \* stamp[f] = epoch at which firm f's live ballot was cast

vars == << epoch, members, phase, ballot, stamp >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ members \subseteq Firms
    /\ phase \in {"voting", "committed", "aborted"}
    /\ ballot \in [Firms -> {"none", "yes", "no"}]
    /\ stamp \in [Firms -> 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ members = Firms
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ ballot = [f \in Firms |-> "none"]
    /\ stamp = [f \in Firms |-> 0]

\* Reconfigure the authorized membership. The epoch is bumped and all ballots are
\* cleared so that no vote cast under the old membership survives.
Reconfigure(newMembers) ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ newMembers # members
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ members' = newMembers
    /\ ballot' = [f \in Firms |-> "none"]
    /\ stamp' = [f \in Firms |-> epoch + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED phase

\* A current member casts its ballot, stamped with the current epoch.
Vote(f, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ f \in members
    /\ ballot[f] = "none"
    /\ ballot' = [ballot EXCEPT ![f] = v]
    /\ stamp' = [stamp EXCEPT ![f] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, members, phase >>

\* The coordinator commits once every current member has voted yes this epoch.
Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A f \in members : ballot[f] = "yes" /\ stamp[f] = epoch
    /\ phase' = "committed"
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, members, ballot, stamp >>

\* The coordinator aborts the round.
Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ phase' = "aborted"
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, members, ballot, stamp >>

\* Once a round is decided, the coordinator reopens for a fresh voting round,
\* clearing all ballots.
Reopen ==
    /\ phase \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ ballot' = [f \in Firms |-> "none"]
    /\ stamp' = [f \in Firms |-> epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, members >>

Next ==
    \/ \E nm \in SUBSET Firms : Reconfigure(nm)
    \/ \E f \in Firms, v \in {"yes", "no"} : Vote(f, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Reopen

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every live ballot belongs to a current member and carries the current epoch.
NoStaleVoter ==
    \A f \in Firms :
        ballot[f] # "none" => (f \in members /\ stamp[f] = epoch)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Firms = {a, b, c}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleVoter
nl:
Scenario: a stock-exchange opening auction committed by two-phase commit, with
runtime membership changes.

Before the market opens, a coordinator runs a two-phase commit over the member
firms that are cleared to trade in today's opening auction. The set of authorized
members can change at runtime: as firms are on-boarded or suspended, the exchange
reconfigures the membership, and every reconfiguration bumps a membership epoch
and clears the round's votes so that no ballot cast under an old membership
carries over.

A vote is legitimate only if it comes from a firm that is a current member and is
stamped with the current epoch. A stale firm -- one suspended in a later
reconfiguration, or whose vote predates the current epoch -- must not have a live
vote on record. The coordinator commits the opening only when every current
member has voted yes at the current epoch.

Actions: the exchange reconfigures the authorized membership, bumping the epoch
and clearing votes (Reconfigure); a current member casts its ballot stamped with
the current epoch (Vote); the coordinator commits the opening when all current
members voted yes this epoch (Commit); the coordinator aborts the round (Abort).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every live vote on record belongs to a currently authorized
member and is stamped with the current membership epoch.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m2p0t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Teams, Rooms

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    pool,      \* unordered set of pending <<team, room>> prepare requests
    outbox,    \* unordered set of <<team, room>> lock-grant messages
    lockedBy,  \* lockedBy[r] = team granted room r's prepare lock, or None
    occupant   \* occupant[r] = team currently occupying room r, or None

vars == << pool, outbox, lockedBy, occupant >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ pool \subseteq (Teams \X Rooms)
    /\ outbox \subseteq (Teams \X Rooms)
    /\ lockedBy \in [Rooms -> Teams \cup {None}]
    /\ occupant \in [Rooms -> Teams \cup {None}]

Init ==
    /\ pool = {}
    /\ outbox = {}
    /\ lockedBy = [r \in Rooms |-> None]
    /\ occupant = [r \in Rooms |-> None]

\* A team drops a prepare request into the unordered request pool.
SendPrepare(t, r) ==
    /\ << t, r >> \notin pool
    /\ pool' = pool \cup {<< t, r >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << outbox, lockedBy, occupant >>

\* The coordinator services any pending request for an unlocked room, granting it
\* the prepare lock and emitting a grant message.
Grant(t, r) ==
    /\ << t, r >> \in pool
    /\ lockedBy[r] = None
    /\ lockedBy' = [lockedBy EXCEPT ![r] = t]
    /\ pool' = pool \ {<< t, r >>}
    /\ outbox' = outbox \cup {<< t, r >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED occupant

\* A team consumes its grant message and occupies the room it was granted.
Commit(t, r) ==
    /\ << t, r >> \in outbox
    /\ lockedBy[r] = t
    /\ occupant[r] = None
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = t]
    /\ outbox' = outbox \ {<< t, r >>}
    /\ UNCHANGED << pool, lockedBy >>

\* An occupying team releases the room, dropping occupancy and freeing the lock.
Release(t, r) ==
    /\ occupant[r] = t
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ lockedBy' = [lockedBy EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << pool, outbox >>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : SendPrepare(t, r)
    \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : Grant(t, r)
    \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : Commit(t, r)
    \/ \E t \in Teams, r \in Rooms : Release(t, r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A team occupies a room only while holding that room's single prepare lock,
\* which forces mutual exclusion of every operating room.
LockedByHolder ==
    \A r \in Rooms : occupant[r] # None => lockedBy[r] = occupant[r]

=============================================================================
nl:
Scenario: a hospital operating-room scheduler using two-phase commit over a
network that can reorder messages.

Surgical teams contend for operating rooms. To take a room a team runs a two-phase
handshake with the room coordinator. First the team sends a prepare request; the
coordinator holds a single prepare lock per room and grants it to at most one team
while the room is unlocked. Only after holding the room's prepare lock may a team
commit and actually occupy the room. Releasing a room drops the team's occupancy
and frees the prepare lock.

The messaging layer may reorder deliveries: prepare requests sit in an unordered
pool and the coordinator may service any pending request in any order. Because the
coordinator grants a room's prepare lock to only one team at a time, and a team
may occupy a room only while it holds that room's lock, two teams can never occupy
the same operating room at once.

Actions: a team sends a prepare request for a room into the unordered pool
(SendPrepare); the coordinator grants an unlocked room's prepare lock to some
pending requester (Grant); a lock-holding team commits and occupies the room
(Commit); an occupying team releases the room and frees its lock (Release).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a team occupies an operating room only while it holds that room's
single prepare lock, so no two teams ever occupy the same room.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m1p6t3 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS N, MaxRound

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N >= 2
ASSUME MaxRound \in Nat /\ MaxRound >= 1

Machines == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(m) == (m + 1) % N

VARIABLES
    holder,   \* the machine currently holding the access token
    round,    \* token round number (mod MaxRound+1)
    serving,  \* serving[m] = TRUE iff machine m is mid-serve
    slow      \* set of congested machines

vars == << holder, round, serving, slow >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Machines
    /\ round \in 0..MaxRound
    /\ serving \in [Machines -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ slow \subseteq Machines

Init ==
    /\ holder = 0
    /\ round = 0
    /\ serving = [m \in Machines |-> FALSE]
    /\ slow = {}

\* The token-holder begins serving a customer.
StartServe(m) ==
    /\ holder = m
    /\ ~serving[m]
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round, slow >>

\* A serving machine finishes and clears its serve.
FinishServe(m) ==
    /\ serving[m]
    /\ serving' = [serving EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round, slow >>

\* An idle, non-congested holder passes the token to the next machine.
PassToken ==
    /\ ~serving[holder]
    /\ holder \notin slow
    /\ holder' = Succ(holder)
    /\ round' = (round + 1) % (MaxRound + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << serving, slow >>

\* A machine becomes congested.
GoSlow(m) ==
    /\ m \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round, serving >>

\* A congested machine recovers.
Resume(m) ==
    /\ m \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round, serving >>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines : StartServe(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : FinishServe(m)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E m \in Machines : GoSlow(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Resume(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A machine is mid-serve only while it holds the ring's single access token.
ServeNeedsToken ==
    \A m \in Machines : serving[m] => holder = m

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    MaxRound = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ServeNeedsToken
nl:
Scenario: a network of vending machines coordinated by a token ring.

Machines are arranged in a ring and share a single circulating access token. Only
the machine currently holding the token may serve a customer (dispense and settle
a purchase). When it is done and not congested, the holder passes the token to the
next machine in the ring, bumping the token's round number.

A machine may be SLOW: a congested machine keeps the token longer and will not
pass it on until it recovers, but it has not failed and always eventually resumes.
Congestion only delays the token; it never lets a non-holder act.

Because a machine may begin serving only while it holds the token, and only the
single token-holder can act, no unauthorized or stale machine -- one that does not
currently hold the token -- can ever perform a serve.

Actions: the token-holder begins serving a customer (StartServe); a serving
machine finishes and clears its serve (FinishServe); an idle, non-congested holder
passes the token to the next machine and bumps the round (PassToken); a machine
becomes congested (GoSlow); a congested machine recovers (Resume).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a vending machine is mid-serve only while it currently holds the
ring's single access token.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m1p1t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS N, MaxVal

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N >= 2
ASSUME MaxVal \in Nat /\ MaxVal >= 1

Stations == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(m) == (m + 1) % N

VARIABLES
    holder,   \* station holding the access token
    record,   \* the shared patient record value (mod MaxVal+1)
    cache,    \* cache[m] = station m's last read of the record
    writing,  \* writing[m] = TRUE iff m has an open write transaction
    crashed   \* set of stations that have crashed silently

vars == << holder, record, cache, writing, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Stations
    /\ record \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ cache \in [Stations -> 0..MaxVal]
    /\ writing \in [Stations -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Stations

Init ==
    /\ holder = 0
    /\ record = 0
    /\ cache = [m \in Stations |-> 0]
    /\ writing = [m \in Stations |-> FALSE]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* The token-holder reads the record into its cache and opens a write.
Read(m) ==
    /\ holder = m
    /\ m \notin crashed
    /\ ~writing[m]
    /\ cache' = [cache EXCEPT ![m] = record]
    /\ writing' = [writing EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, record, crashed >>

\* The holder commits its update, but only if its cached read still matches the
\* live record. The record advances and the cache follows it.
Write(m) ==
    /\ holder = m
    /\ m \notin crashed
    /\ writing[m]
    /\ cache[m] = record
    /\ record' = (record + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)
    /\ cache' = [cache EXCEPT ![m] = (record + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)]
    /\ writing' = [writing EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, crashed >>

\* An idle holder passes the token onward; a crashed holder is skipped.
PassToken ==
    /\ (holder \in crashed) \/ (~writing[holder])
    /\ holder' = Succ(holder)
    /\ UNCHANGED << record, cache, writing, crashed >>

\* A station crashes silently, abandoning any open write.
Crash(m) ==
    /\ m \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {m}
    /\ writing' = [writing EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, record, cache >>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Stations : Read(m)
    \/ \E m \in Stations : Write(m)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E m \in Stations : Crash(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A station with an open write holds a cached read equal to the live record.
NoLostUpdate ==
    \A m \in Stations : writing[m] => cache[m] = record

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    N = 3
    MaxVal = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
Scenario: a hospital operating-room scheduler whose staff update one shared
patient record under a token ring, where a station can crash silently.

Scheduling stations sit in a ring sharing a single access token. Only the station
holding the token may touch the shared patient record, and it does so as a
read-modify-write: it first reads the current record into a local cache, then
commits an update that advances the record. Because only the token-holder can
write and it must pass the token before anyone else acts, no two updates
interleave, so no update is ever lost by being overwritten on top of a stale read.

A station may crash silently: it simply stops participating. A crashing station
abandons any transaction it had open (its pending read is discarded), and the ring
lets the token move past a crashed station so the system keeps going.

An update commits only if the writer's cached read still matches the live record,
which holds because no other writer can advance the record while one station holds
the token.

Actions: the token-holder reads the record into its cache and opens a write
(Read); the holder commits, advancing the record, only if its cache still matches
(Write); an idle holder passes the token onward, skipping crashed stations
(PassToken); a station crashes silently, abandoning its open read (Crash).

SAFETY PROPERTY: any station with an open write holds a cached read equal to the
live shared record, so no committed update is lost by overwriting a stale read.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m9p6t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Routers, MaxEpoch

ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat /\ MaxEpoch >= 1

VARIABLES
    epoch,        \* current configuration epoch (cyclic 0..MaxEpoch)
    authorized,   \* set of routers authorized in the current epoch
    believes,     \* believes[r] = epoch router r has synced to
    routing,      \* routing[r] = TRUE iff r has a live routing operation
    crashed       \* set of routers that have crashed silently

vars == << epoch, authorized, believes, routing, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ authorized \subseteq Routers
    /\ believes \in [Routers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ routing \in [Routers -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Routers

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ authorized = Routers
    /\ believes = [r \in Routers |-> 0]
    /\ routing = [r \in Routers |-> FALSE]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* The controller reconfigures: bump the (cyclic) epoch, install a new authorized
\* set, and cancel all in-progress routes.
Reconfigure(newAuth) ==
    /\ newAuth # authorized
    /\ epoch' = (epoch + 1) % (MaxEpoch + 1)
    /\ authorized' = newAuth
    /\ routing' = [r \in Routers |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << believes, crashed >>

\* An authorized, live router syncs its belief to the current epoch.
Sync(r) ==
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ r \in authorized
    /\ believes[r] # epoch
    /\ believes' = [believes EXCEPT ![r] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, authorized, routing, crashed >>

\* A synced, authorized router starts routing a bag.
Route(r) ==
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ r \in authorized
    /\ believes[r] = epoch
    /\ ~routing[r]
    /\ routing' = [routing EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, authorized, believes, crashed >>

\* A routing router completes its operation.
Finish(r) ==
    /\ routing[r]
    /\ routing' = [routing EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, authorized, believes, crashed >>

\* A router crashes silently, abandoning any live route.
Crash(r) ==
    /\ r \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {r}
    /\ routing' = [routing EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, authorized, believes >>

Next ==
    \/ \E na \in SUBSET Routers : Reconfigure(na)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Sync(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Route(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Finish(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Crash(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every router with a live route is authorized now and synced to this epoch.
NoStaleRouting ==
    \A r \in Routers :
        routing[r] => (r \in authorized /\ believes[r] = epoch)

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Routers = {r1, r2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next

nl:
Scenario: an airport baggage router coordinated by epoch-numbered reconfiguration,
where a router can crash silently.

A bank of baggage routers moves bags between belts. The controller publishes a
configuration stamped with an epoch number listing which routers are authorized.
Whenever the layout changes, the controller reconfigures: it bumps the epoch,
installs a new authorized set, and cancels every route in progress so that no
work started under the previous configuration carries over.

A router may act only after it has synced to the current epoch, and only if it is
in the current authorized set. A stale router -- one that has not adopted the
current epoch, or that was dropped from the authorized set -- must never have a
live routing operation. A router may crash silently: it stops participating and
abandons any route it had underway.

Actions: the controller reconfigures, bumping the epoch, installing a new
authorized set, and cancelling all in-progress routes (Reconfigure); an authorized
router syncs its belief to the current epoch (Sync); a synced, authorized router
starts routing a bag (Route); a routing router completes (Finish); a router
crashes silently, abandoning its route (Crash).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every router with a live routing operation is in the current
authorized set and has synced to the current epoch.

CONSTANTS Cranes, Holds, Quorum, Cap

ASSUME Quorum \in Nat /\ Quorum >= 1
ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ Cap >= 1

VARIABLES
    approvals,  \* approvals[h] = set of cranes approving the next load of h
    load,       \* load[h] = number of containers in hold h
    slow        \* set of congested cranes

vars == << approvals, load, slow >>

Slack == Cap + 2  \* type slack so the capacity bound is not typing-trivial

TypeOK ==
    /\ approvals \in [Holds -> SUBSET Cranes]
    /\ load \in [Holds -> 0..Slack]
    /\ slow \subseteq Cranes

Init ==
    /\ approvals = [h \in Holds |-> {}]
    /\ load = [h \in Holds |-> 0]
    /\ slow = {}

\* A non-congested crane approves loading a hold.
Vote(c, h) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ c \notin approvals[h]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![h] = @ \cup {c}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << load, slow >>

\* The controller loads one container into a hold that reached quorum and is
\* below capacity, then clears that hold's approvals.
Load(h) ==
    /\ Cardinality(approvals[h]) >= Quorum
    /\ load[h] < Cap
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![h] = @ + 1]
    /\ approvals' = [approvals EXCEPT ![h] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED slow

\* A container is removed from a non-empty hold.
Unload(h) ==
    /\ load[h] > 0
    /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![h] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << approvals, slow >>

\* A crane becomes congested.
GoSlow(c) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED << approvals, load >>

\* A congested crane recovers.
Resume(c) ==
    /\ c \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED << approvals, load >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, h \in Holds : Vote(c, h)
    \/ \E h \in Holds : Load(h)
    \/ \E h \in Holds : Unload(h)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : GoSlow(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Resume(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No hold ever holds more containers than its fixed capacity.
WithinCapacity ==
    \A h \in Holds : load[h] <= Cap

Scenario: a container-ship crane yard loading holds by quorum vote, with cranes
that can be slow but never failed.

Gantry cranes load containers into the ship's holds. Each hold has a fixed
capacity. Before another container is loaded into a hold, the cranes hold a quorum
vote: enough distinct cranes must approve. When a hold collects a quorum of
approvals, the yard controller loads one container into it -- but only while the
hold is below its capacity -- and then clears that hold's approvals so the next
container needs a fresh vote. Containers can also be unloaded.

A crane may be SLOW: a congested crane casts no new approvals until it recovers,
but it has not failed. Congestion only delays voting; it never lets a hold be
loaded past its capacity.

Actions: a non-congested crane approves loading a hold (Vote); the controller
loads one container into a hold that has reached quorum and is below capacity,
clearing that hold's approvals (Load); a container is removed from a non-empty
hold (Unload); a crane becomes congested (GoSlow); a congested crane recovers
(Resume).

SAFETY PROPERTY: no hold ever contains more containers than its fixed capacity.

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers, Blocks, Trains, Quorum

ASSUME Quorum \in Nat /\ Quorum >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    proposal,   \* proposal[b] = train proposed for block b, or None
    voters,     \* voters[b] = controllers who approved b's current proposal
    lockOwner,  \* lockOwner[b] = train granted b's lock, or None
    occupant,   \* occupant[b] = train occupying b, or None
    crashed     \* set of controllers that crashed silently

vars == << proposal, voters, lockOwner, occupant, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ proposal \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {None}]
    /\ voters \in [Blocks -> SUBSET Controllers]
    /\ lockOwner \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {None}]
    /\ occupant \in [Blocks -> Trains \cup {None}]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Controllers

Init ==
    /\ proposal = [b \in Blocks |-> None]
    /\ voters = [b \in Blocks |-> {}]
    /\ lockOwner = [b \in Blocks |-> None]
    /\ occupant = [b \in Blocks |-> None]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* Record a proposal naming a train for a free, unlocked block.
Propose(b, tr) ==
    /\ proposal[b] = None
    /\ lockOwner[b] = None
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![b] = tr]
    /\ UNCHANGED << voters, lockOwner, occupant, crashed >>

\* A live controller approves the current proposal on a block.
Vote(b, c) ==
    /\ proposal[b] # None
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ c \notin voters[b]
    /\ voters' = [voters EXCEPT ![b] = @ \cup {c}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, lockOwner, occupant, crashed >>

\* Once a quorum approves, grant the block's lock to the proposed train.
Grant(b) ==
    /\ proposal[b] # None
    /\ lockOwner[b] = None
    /\ Cardinality(voters[b]) >= Quorum
    /\ lockOwner' = [lockOwner EXCEPT ![b] = proposal[b]]
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![b] = None]
    /\ voters' = [voters EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << occupant, crashed >>

\* The train named by a block's lock occupies the block.
Occupy(b, tr) ==
    /\ lockOwner[b] = tr
    /\ occupant[b] = None
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![b] = tr]
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, voters, lockOwner, crashed >>

\* Release a block, clearing its occupancy and lock.
Release(b) ==
    /\ occupant[b] # None
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![b] = None]
    /\ lockOwner' = [lockOwner EXCEPT ![b] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, voters, crashed >>

\* A controller crashes silently.
Crash(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED << proposal, voters, lockOwner, occupant >>

\* A proposal that cannot reach quorum (e.g. after crashes) is withdrawn.
Withdraw(b) ==
    /\ proposal[b] # None
    /\ proposal' = [proposal EXCEPT ![b] = None]
    /\ voters' = [voters EXCEPT ![b] = {}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << lockOwner, occupant, crashed >>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Blocks, tr \in Trains : Propose(b, tr)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks, c \in Controllers : Vote(b, c)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Grant(b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks, tr \in Trains : Occupy(b, tr)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Release(b)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Withdraw(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A train occupies a block only while that block's lock names the same train.
OccupantOwnsLock ==
    \A b \in Blocks : occupant[b] # None => lockOwner[b] = occupant[b]

nl:
Scenario: a subway signalling block system that allocates track blocks to trains
by quorum vote, where a signal controller can crash silently.

The track is divided into blocks. A block may be allocated to at most one train at
a time. To allocate a block to a train, the signal controllers first record a
proposal naming that train for that block, then vote on it; when a quorum of
controllers has approved the proposal, the block's lock is granted to the proposed
train and the proposal is cleared. A train occupies a block only after the block's
lock names that train. Releasing a block clears both its occupancy and its lock.

A controller may crash silently: it stops casting votes. Remaining controllers can
still reach a quorum on the votes already gathered.

Because a block's lock names a single train and a train occupies a block only
while the lock names it, a block is never allocated to two trains at once.

Actions: controllers record a proposal naming a train for a free block (Propose);
a live controller approves the current proposal (Vote); the block's lock is
granted to the proposed train once a quorum approves, clearing the proposal
(Grant); the named train occupies the block (Occupy); a block is released,
clearing its occupancy and lock (Release); a controller crashes silently (Crash);
a proposal that can no longer reach quorum is withdrawn (Withdraw).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a train occupies a track block only while that block's lock names
that same train, so no block is ever allocated to two trains at once.

CONSTANTS N, Cap, MaxRound, MaxQueue

ASSUME N \in Nat /\ N >= 2
ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ Cap >= 1

Routers == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(m) == (m + 1) % N
Slack == Cap + 2  \* type slack so the capacity bound is not typing-trivial

VARIABLES
    holder,   \* router holding the token
    round,    \* token round number (mod MaxRound+1)
    belt,     \* number of bags on the conveyor belt
    queue     \* queue[m] = bags queued locally at router m

vars == << holder, round, belt, queue >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ holder \in Routers
    /\ round \in 0..MaxRound
    /\ belt \in 0..Slack
    /\ queue \in [Routers -> 0..MaxQueue]

Init ==
    /\ holder = 0
    /\ round = 0
    /\ belt = 0
    /\ queue = [m \in Routers |-> 0]

\* A bag arrives and joins some router's local queue.
Arrive(m) ==
    /\ queue[m] < MaxQueue
    /\ queue' = [queue EXCEPT ![m] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round, belt >>

\* The token-holder pushes one queued bag onto the belt, only while below cap.
Push ==
    /\ queue[holder] > 0
    /\ belt < Cap
    /\ belt' = belt + 1
    /\ queue' = [queue EXCEPT ![holder] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round >>

\* A bag is carried off the end of the belt.
Remove ==
    /\ belt > 0
    /\ belt' = belt - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << holder, round, queue >>

\* The holder passes the token to the next router, bumping the round.
PassToken ==
    /\ holder' = Succ(holder)
    /\ round' = (round + 1) % (MaxRound + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << belt, queue >>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Routers : Arrive(m)
    \/ Push
    \/ Remove
    \/ PassToken

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* The belt never carries more bags than its fixed capacity.
WithinCapacity ==
    belt <= Cap

nl:
Scenario: an airport baggage router feeding a bounded conveyor belt under a token
ring, over a network that can reorder messages.

Routers sit in a ring sharing a single access token. Bags arrive at the routers in
any order and queue locally. Only the router currently holding the token may push
one of its queued bags onto the shared conveyor belt, and only while the belt is
below its fixed capacity. Because arrivals are recorded per router and the token
circulates, the holder may service queued bags in any order -- the message order
does not matter. Bags are carried off the far end of the belt as it advances.

The belt has a hard capacity: a push is allowed only when the belt is strictly
below capacity, so the belt is never overfilled no matter how arrivals and token
passes interleave.

Actions: a bag arrives and joins some router's local queue (Arrive); the
token-holder pushes one queued bag onto the belt while the belt is below capacity
(Push); a bag is carried off the end of the belt (Remove); the holder passes the
token to the next router in the ring, bumping the round (PassToken).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of bags on the conveyor belt never exceeds its fixed
capacity.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m6p3t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cranes, Slots, MaxTTL

ASSUME MaxTTL \in Nat /\ MaxTTL >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    leaseOwner,  \* leaseOwner[s] = crane owning slot s's lease, or None
    ttl,         \* ttl[s] = remaining lease time on slot s (0 = free)
    claimed,     \* claimed[c] = set of slots crane c believes it owns
    grantedBy    \* grantedBy[s] = controller that granted s's lease, or None

vars == << leaseOwner, ttl, claimed, grantedBy >>

Instances == {"ctrlA", "ctrlB"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaseOwner \in [Slots -> Cranes \cup {None}]
    /\ ttl \in [Slots -> 0..MaxTTL]
    /\ claimed \in [Cranes -> SUBSET Slots]
    /\ grantedBy \in [Slots -> Instances \cup {None}]

Init ==
    /\ leaseOwner = [s \in Slots |-> None]
    /\ ttl = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
    /\ claimed = [c \in Cranes |-> {}]
    /\ grantedBy = [s \in Slots |-> None]

\* A controller grants a free slot's lease to a crane out of the shared pool.
Acquire(inst, c, s) ==
    /\ leaseOwner[s] = None
    /\ ttl[s] = 0
    /\ leaseOwner' = [leaseOwner EXCEPT ![s] = c]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![s] = MaxTTL]
    /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![c] = @ \cup {s}]
    /\ grantedBy' = [grantedBy EXCEPT ![s] = inst]

AcquireA(c, s) == Acquire("ctrlA", c, s)
AcquireB(c, s) == Acquire("ctrlB", c, s)

\* A lease ticks down; on reaching zero it is cleared from ownership and from
\* every crane's claim.
Tick(s) ==
    /\ ttl[s] > 0
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1]
    /\ IF ttl[s] - 1 = 0
       THEN /\ leaseOwner' = [leaseOwner EXCEPT ![s] = None]
            /\ claimed' = [c \in Cranes |-> claimed[c] \ {s}]
            /\ grantedBy' = [grantedBy EXCEPT ![s] = None]
       ELSE UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, claimed, grantedBy >>

\* An owner refreshes its live lease's time-to-live.
Renew(c, s) ==
    /\ leaseOwner[s] = c
    /\ ttl[s] > 0
    /\ grantedBy[s] # None
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![s] = MaxTTL]
    /\ UNCHANGED << leaseOwner, claimed, grantedBy >>

\* A crane releases its slot, freeing the lease.
Release(c, s) ==
    /\ s \in claimed[c]
    /\ claimed' = [claimed EXCEPT ![c] = @ \ {s}]
    /\ leaseOwner' = [leaseOwner EXCEPT ![s] = None]
    /\ ttl' = [ttl EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
    /\ grantedBy' = [grantedBy EXCEPT ![s] = None]

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : AcquireA(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : AcquireB(c, s)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Tick(s)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : Renew(c, s)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : Release(c, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A crane claims a slot only while it is the named owner of that slot's lease.
ClaimImpliesOwner ==
    \A c \in Cranes, s \in Slots : s \in claimed[c] => leaseOwner[s] = c

CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {c1, c2}
    Slots = {s1, s2}
    MaxTTL = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next

nl:
Scenario: a container-ship crane yard using lease-based ownership of stow-slots
with expiry, where two independent yard controllers share one slot pool.

Cranes take stow-slots on lease. A lease names one crane as the slot's owner and
carries a time-to-live that counts down; when it expires the slot returns to the
shared pool and its owner's claim is dropped. Two independent yard controllers
grant leases out of the same single pool: whichever controller grants a lease
records the same ownership, so both must respect a slot that is already leased and
cannot hand it out again until it is free.

A crane keeps a slot in its claimed set only while it genuinely owns the live
lease. On expiry the slot's ownership is cleared and it is removed from every
crane's claimed set, so no crane ever believes it owns an expired slot.

Because a slot's lease names a single owner, the same slot is never leased to two
cranes at once.

Actions: controller one grants a free slot's lease to a crane (AcquireA);
controller two grants a free slot's lease to a crane from the same pool (AcquireB);
a lease's time-to-live ticks down, and on reaching zero the lease is cleared from
ownership and from every crane's claim (Tick); an owner refreshes its live lease's
time-to-live (Renew); a crane releases its slot, freeing the lease (Release).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a crane keeps a slot in its claimed set only while it is the named
owner of that slot's lease, so no slot is leased to two cranes at once.

ASSUME MaxRound \in Nat /\ MaxRound >= 1

Patrons == 0 .. (N - 1)
Succ(p) == (p + 1) % N
None == N  \* numeric sentinel outside the patron range

VARIABLES
    token,    \* patron currently holding the ring token
    granted,  \* patron holding the reading-room access grant, or None
    inRoom,   \* inRoom[p] = TRUE iff patron p is in the reading room
    round     \* token round number (mod MaxRound+1)

    /\ granted = None
    /\ inRoom = [p \in Patrons |-> FALSE]

    /\ granted = None
    /\ granted' = p

    /\ ~inRoom[p]

    /\ granted' = None

    /\ granted' = p
    /\ UNCHANGED << token, inRoom, round >>

    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Leave(p)
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : AdminOverride(p)

    \A p \in Patrons : inRoom[p] => granted = p

Scenario: a library reservation system granting exclusive use of a single reading
room by token ring, with a privileged admin override.

Patrons take turns holding a circulating token. The token-holder may take the
access grant for the shared reading room while the grant is free; only the patron
who holds the access grant may enter the room, and on leaving the patron returns
the grant. The token advances around the ring only while the grant is free.

There is a privileged admin override: a librarian may hand the access grant
directly to any patron, bypassing the token order, but only while the grant is
free, so the override never creates a second simultaneous grant.

Because the access grant names a single patron and a patron is in the reading room
only while it holds the grant, at most one patron is ever in the room at once.

enters the reading room (Enter); an occupant leaves and returns the grant (Leave);
the token advances while the grant is free (PassToken); the librarian hands the
free grant directly to any patron, bypassing token order (AdminOverride).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a patron is in the reading room only while it holds the single
access grant, so no two patrons are ever in the room at once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m7p2t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Floors, Cars, Total, MaxReg

ASSUME Total \in Nat /\ Total >= 1
ASSUME MaxReg \in Nat /\ MaxReg >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    waiting,     \* waiting[f] = passengers waiting on floor f
    carLoad,     \* carLoad[k] = passengers currently in car k
    reg,         \* compare-and-swap sequence register
    regOwner     \* car that currently owns the register, or None

vars == << waiting, carLoad, reg, regOwner >>

RECURSIVE SumWaiting(_)
SumWaiting(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET f == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN waiting[f] + SumWaiting(S \ {f})

RECURSIVE SumLoad(_)
SumLoad(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET k == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN carLoad[k] + SumLoad(S \ {k})

TypeOK ==
    /\ waiting \in [Floors -> 0..Total]
    /\ carLoad \in [Cars -> 0..Total]
    /\ reg \in 0..MaxReg
    /\ regOwner \in Cars \cup {None}

Init ==
    /\ waiting = [f \in Floors |-> IF f = CHOOSE x \in Floors : TRUE THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ carLoad = [k \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ reg = 0
    /\ regOwner = None

\* A car acquires the free compare-and-swap register, bumping its sequence.
AcquireReg(k) ==
    /\ regOwner = None
    /\ regOwner' = k
    /\ reg' = (reg + 1) % (MaxReg + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << waiting, carLoad >>

\* The register-owning car boards one waiting passenger from a floor.
Board(k, f) ==
    /\ regOwner = k
    /\ waiting[f] > 0
    /\ carLoad[k] < Total
    /\ waiting' = [waiting EXCEPT ![f] = @ - 1]
    /\ carLoad' = [carLoad EXCEPT ![k] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << reg, regOwner >>

\* The register-owning car lets one passenger alight to a floor.
Alight(k, f) ==
    /\ regOwner = k
    /\ carLoad[k] > 0
    /\ waiting[f] < Total
    /\ carLoad' = [carLoad EXCEPT ![k] = @ - 1]
    /\ waiting' = [waiting EXCEPT ![f] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << reg, regOwner >>

\* The owning car releases the register.
ReleaseReg(k) ==
    /\ regOwner = k
    /\ regOwner' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED << waiting, carLoad, reg >>

Next ==
    \/ \E k \in Cars : AcquireReg(k)
    \/ \E k \in Cars, f \in Floors : Board(k, f)
    \/ \E k \in Cars, f \in Floors : Alight(k, f)
    \/ \E k \in Cars : ReleaseReg(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Passengers are conserved: the total across floors and cars never changes.
Conservation ==
    SumWaiting(Floors) + SumLoad(Cars) = Total

CONSTANTS

    Cars = {ca, cb}

NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
Scenario: an elevator bank in a skyscraper moving passengers, coordinated by a
compare-and-swap register, where two cars share one pool of waiting passengers.

A fixed population of passengers is distributed across the floors and the cars;
none are ever created or destroyed, they only move. Two elevator cars draw from
the same shared pool of waiting passengers. To perform a boarding or alighting
operation a car must first own a shared compare-and-swap register: the register is
acquired only when free (a successful compare-and-swap that bumps its sequence
number), giving the car exclusive right to move passengers, and released
afterwards.

While it owns the register, a car may board a waiting passenger from a floor
(passenger leaves the floor, joins the car) or let a passenger alight (passenger
leaves the car, joins a floor). Every such move transfers exactly one passenger
from one place to another, so the total number of passengers is invariant.

Actions: a car acquires the free compare-and-swap register, bumping its sequence
(AcquireReg); the register-owning car boards one waiting passenger from a floor
(Board); the register-owning car lets one passenger alight to a floor (Alight);
the owning car releases the register (ReleaseReg).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of passengers across all floors and all cars
always equals the fixed starting population.

    term,    \* current leadership term (mod MaxTerm+1)
    onDock,  \* onDock[r] = TRUE iff robot r occupies the charging dock
    down     \* set of robots that have failed and are down

    bookLock      \* bookLock[b] = branch holding b's fine lock, or None

    /\ catalogLock = None

    /\ bookLock[b] = None

    /\ bookLock[b] = br

    /\ \A b \in Books : bookLock[b] # br

    \/ \E br \in Branches, b \in Books : Checkout(br, b)
    \/ \E br \in Branches, b \in Books : ReleaseBook(br, b)
    \/ \E br \in Branches : ReleaseCatalog(br)

Scenario: a library book reservation system using hierarchical locks (a coarse
catalog lock, then a fine per-book lock), where two branches share one book pool.

Two branch servers reserve books out of one shared catalog. Checking out a book is
irreversible: once a book is checked out it leaves the available pool for good and
joins the checked-out set. To check out a book a branch must take locks in
hierarchical order: first the single coarse catalog lock, then the fine lock on the
specific book. A branch releases the fine book lock before releasing the coarse
catalog lock.

checkout moves it out of available and into checked-out, a book is never
simultaneously available and checked out -- so the irreversible checkout of any one
book happens at most once.

catalog-lock holder acquires the fine lock on an unlocked book (AcquireBook); the
book-lock holder irreversibly checks the book out, moving it from available to
checked-out (Checkout); the holder releases a fine book lock (ReleaseBook); the
holder releases the coarse catalog lock once it holds no book locks
(ReleaseCatalog).

SAFETY PROPERTY: no book is ever both in the available pool and in the checked-out
set at the same time.

    reserved,  \* reserved[r] = TRUE iff r holds a reservation
    acting     \* acting[r] = TRUE iff r is performing its task

    /\ resVer \in [Robots -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ reserved \in [Robots -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ acting \in [Robots -> BOOLEAN]

    /\ ver = 0
    /\ resVer = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
    /\ reserved = [r \in Robots |-> FALSE]
    /\ acting = [r \in Robots |-> FALSE]

\* A robot takes a reservation stamped with the current version.
Reserve(r) ==
    /\ ~reserved[r]
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ resVer' = [resVer EXCEPT ![r] = ver]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, acting >>

\* A robot with a current (non-stale) reservation begins acting.
Act(r) ==
    /\ reserved[r]
    /\ resVer[r] = ver
    /\ ~acting[r]
    /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![r] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, resVer, reserved >>

Retry(r) ==
    /\ reserved[r]
    /\ resVer[r] # ver
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, resVer, acting >>

\* An acting robot finishes and releases its reservation.

    /\ acting[r]
    /\ acting' = [acting EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![r] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << ver, resVer >>

\* staling every outstanding reservation.
AdminOverride ==
    /\ ver' = (ver + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ acting' = [r \in Robots |-> FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << resVer, reserved >>

    \/ \E r \in Robots : Reserve(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Act(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Retry(r)
    \/ \E r \in Robots : Finish(r)
    \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A robot acts only while holding a reservation stamped with the current version.
NoStaleAction ==
    \A r \in Robots : acting[r] => (reserved[r] /\ resVer[r] = ver)

nl:
Scenario: a warehouse robot fleet updating task reservations by optimistic locking
with retry, with a privileged admin override.

A shared dispatch register carries a version number. A robot reserves the right to
run its authorized task by grabbing a reservation stamped with the version it read.
It may actually act only while its reservation is current -- its stamped version
still equals the register's version. If the version has moved on, the reservation
is stale and the robot must drop it and retry with a fresh read.

There is a privileged admin override: a supervisor bumps the register's version,
which cancels every task in progress. This does not by itself clear robots'
reservations, but it makes them stale, so any robot whose reservation predates the
bump must retry before it can act again.

Because a robot acts only while holding a reservation stamped with the current
version, no stale or unauthorized robot ever performs its task.

Actions: a robot takes a reservation stamped with the current version (Reserve); a
robot with a current reservation begins acting (Act); a robot drops a stale
reservation to retry (Retry); an acting robot finishes and releases its reservation
(Finish); the supervisor bumps the version, cancelling tasks in progress and
staling old reservations (AdminOverride).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a robot is acting only while holding a reservation stamped with
the dispatch register's current version.

    holding,  \* holding[w] = requests worker w is processing
    done      \* completed requests

SumHold(S) ==

    /\ queue < Cap

    /\ queue' = queue + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << holding, done >>

    /\ queue > 0
    /\ queue' = queue - 1
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![w] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << waiting, done >>

    /\ holding[w] > 0
    /\ holding' = [holding EXCEPT ![w] = @ - 1]
    /\ done' = done + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << waiting, queue >>

\* A completed request is recycled back to waiting.

    /\ done > 0
    /\ done' = done - 1
    /\ waiting' = waiting + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED << queue, holding >>

    \/ Enqueue
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Take(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Complete(w)
    \/ Recycle

ASSUME MaxVal \in Nat /\ MaxVal >= 1
ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat /\ MaxCap >= 1

    version,    \* version tag of the shared allocation record
    record,     \* the shared shed-load allocation value
    committing, \* TRUE iff an update is staged for commit
    stagedVer,  \* version the staged update was computed against
    capacity    \* current grid capacity (changes at runtime)

    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ record \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ committing \in BOOLEAN
    /\ stagedVer \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ version = 0
    /\ record = 0
    /\ committing = FALSE
    /\ stagedVer = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

\* Stage a new allocation computed against the current version.
Prepare ==
    /\ ~committing
    /\ committing' = TRUE
    /\ stagedVer' = version
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, record, capacity >>

\* Commit the staged allocation only if still based on the current version.
Commit ==
    /\ committing
    /\ stagedVer = version
    /\ record' = (record + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ committing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << stagedVer, capacity >>

\* Roll back a staged allocation before commit.
Rollback ==
    /\ committing
    /\ committing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << version, record, stagedVer, capacity >>

\* Change the grid capacity, bumping the version and cancelling any staged update.
CapacityChange(c) ==
    /\ c # capacity
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ committing' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED << record, stagedVer >>

Next ==
    \/ Prepare
    \/ Commit
    \/ Rollback
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : CapacityChange(c)

\* A staged update is always based on the record's current version.

    committing => stagedVer = version

    MaxVal = 2
    MaxCap = 2

NEXT Next

nl:
Scenario: a power-grid load shedder updating one shared allocation record by
two-phase commit, where the grid capacity can change at runtime.

A shared record holds the current shed-load allocation, tagged with a version
number. Updating it uses two phases: a prepare phase stages a new allocation
computed against the current version, and a commit phase applies the staged value
only if the version has not moved since staging, advancing both the record and its
version. A staged update may also be rolled back before commit.

The grid capacity can change at runtime. A capacity change bumps the version and
cancels any staged update, because that update was computed against the old
capacity and committing it would lose the capacity change. So a staged update is
committed only while it is still based on the current version; it is never applied
on top of a stale version.

Actions: stage a new allocation against the current version (Prepare); commit the
staged allocation, advancing the record and version, only if still current
(Commit); roll back a staged allocation (Rollback); change the grid capacity,
bumping the version and cancelling any staged update (CapacityChange).

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever an update is staged for commit, its staged version equals
the record's current version, so no update is committed on top of a stale version.

    readVer,  \* readVer[b] = version b cached at its read
    crashed   \* set of banks that have crashed (at most one)

vars == << balance, version, reading, readVal, readVer, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ balance \in 0..MaxVal
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ reading \in [Banks -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ readVal \in [Banks -> 0..MaxVal]
    /\ readVer \in [Banks -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Banks

Init ==
    /\ balance = 0
    /\ version = 0
    /\ reading = [b \in Banks |-> FALSE]
    /\ readVal = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ readVer = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* A live bank reads the balance and version into its cache, opening a posting.
Read(b) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ ~reading[b]
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
    /\ readVal' = [readVal EXCEPT ![b] = balance]
    /\ readVer' = [readVer EXCEPT ![b] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED << balance, version, crashed >>

\* A bank commits its posting only if its cached version is still current.
Write(b) ==
    /\ b \notin crashed
    /\ reading[b]
    /\ readVer[b] = version
    /\ balance' = (balance + 1) % (MaxVal + 1)
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << readVal, readVer, crashed >>

\* A bank aborts a stale read to retry.
AbortStale(b) ==
    /\ reading[b]
    /\ readVer[b] # version
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << balance, version, readVal, readVer, crashed >>

\* A single bank crashes silently, abandoning its open read.
Crash(b) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {b}
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << balance, version, readVal, readVer >>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Read(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Write(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : AbortStale(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Crash(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A bank whose cached read is still current holds a cached balance matching the
\* live balance, so no posting is silently lost.
NoLostUpdate ==
    \A b \in Banks :
        (reading[b] /\ readVer[b] = version) => readVal[b] = balance

    MaxVer = 2

NEXT Next

nl:
Scenario: a bank interbank settlement batch updating one shared settlement balance
by optimistic locking, where a single bank can crash silently.

Banks post settlements against a shared balance carrying a version number. A bank
runs a read-modify-write: it reads the current balance and version into a local
cache, then commits a posting only if the version has not moved since -- a commit
advances the balance and bumps the version. If the version moved first, the read
is stale and the bank aborts to retry. Because a committing bank always bumps the
version, a bank whose cached read is still at the current version is guaranteed
that no posting has slipped in behind its back, so no update is silently lost.

A single bank may crash silently: it stops posting and abandons any open read. At
most one bank ever crashes, so a live bank always remains.

Actions: a live bank reads the balance and version into its cache, opening a
posting (Read); a bank commits its posting, advancing the balance and version, only
if its cached version is still current (Write); a bank aborts a stale read to retry
(AbortStale); a single bank crashes silently, abandoning its open read (Crash).

SAFETY PROPERTY: any bank whose cached read is still at the current version holds a
cached balance equal to the live settlement balance, so no posting is silently
lost.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m0p1t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences

CONSTANTS Ctrls, MaxLen

ASSUME MaxLen \in Nat /\ MaxLen >= 1

VARIABLES
    log,      \* shared ordered log of committed [who, base] entries
    reading,  \* reading[c] = TRUE iff c has an open optimistic append
    snapLen,  \* snapLen[c] = log length c snapshotted when it began
    crashed   \* set of controllers that crashed (at most one)

vars == << log, reading, snapLen, crashed >>

Entry == [who : Ctrls, base : 0..MaxLen]

TypeOK ==
    /\ log \in Seq(Entry)
    /\ Len(log) <= MaxLen
    /\ reading \in [Ctrls -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ snapLen \in [Ctrls -> 0..MaxLen]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Ctrls

Init ==
    /\ log = << >>
    /\ reading = [c \in Ctrls |-> FALSE]
    /\ snapLen = [c \in Ctrls |-> 0]
    /\ crashed = {}

\* A live controller snapshots the current log length, opening an append.
Read(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ ~reading[c]
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
    /\ snapLen' = [snapLen EXCEPT ![c] = Len(log)]
    /\ UNCHANGED << log, crashed >>

\* A controller commits an append recording its snapshot length, only if the log
\* is still exactly that length.
Commit(c) ==
    /\ c \notin crashed
    /\ reading[c]
    /\ snapLen[c] = Len(log)
    /\ Len(log) < MaxLen
    /\ log' = Append(log, [who |-> c, base |-> snapLen[c]])
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << snapLen, crashed >>

\* A controller aborts a stale snapshot to retry.
AbortStale(c) ==
    /\ reading[c]
    /\ snapLen[c] # Len(log)
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << log, snapLen, crashed >>

\* A single controller crashes silently, abandoning its open read.
Crash(c) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {c}
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED << log, snapLen >>

\* The interlocking flushes the processed log, clearing it.
Archive ==
    /\ Len(log) > 0
    /\ log' = << >>
    /\ UNCHANGED << reading, snapLen, crashed >>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : Read(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : Commit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : AbortStale(c)
    \/ \E c \in Ctrls : Crash(c)
    \/ Archive

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Every entry at position i snapshotted length i-1: the log grew contiguously.
LogContiguity ==
    \A i \in DOMAIN log : log[i].base = i - 1

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Ctrls = {ct1, ct2}
    MaxLen = 3
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT LogContiguity
nl:
Scenario: a subway signalling block system whose controllers append occupancy
updates to one shared ordered log by optimistic locking, where a single controller
can crash silently.

Signal controllers record block-occupancy updates by appending to a shared ordered
log. Appending is optimistic: a controller first reads the current log length as a
snapshot, and commits its append only if the log length has not grown since -- that
is, only if no other controller appended in the meantime. Each committed entry
records the log length the committer had snapshotted. If the log grew first, the
snapshot is stale and the controller aborts to retry.

Because a controller appends only when the log is exactly the length it saw, every
committed entry extended the log by exactly one over what its author had seen: the
log grows contiguously with no update overwritten or lost.

A single controller may crash silently, abandoning its open read; at most one
controller ever crashes.

Actions: a live controller snapshots the current log length, opening an append
(Read); a controller commits an append recording its snapshot length, only if the
log is still that length (Commit); a controller aborts a stale snapshot to retry
(AbortStale); a single controller crashes silently, abandoning its read (Crash);
the interlocking flushes the processed log, clearing it (Archive).

SAFETY PROPERTY: every entry at position i in the shared log recorded a snapshot
length of i-1, so the log grew contiguously and no update was lost.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od19m0p3t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Patrons, Copies, MaxSeq

ASSUME MaxSeq \in Nat /\ MaxSeq >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    slot,        \* slot[cp] = patron holding copy cp's reservation, or None
    confirmed,   \* confirmed[p] = set of copies patron p has confirmed
    inSwap,      \* inSwap[cp] = patron whose swap is open on cp, or None
    seq          \* seq[cp] = compare-and-swap sequence number of copy cp

vars == << slot, confirmed, inSwap, seq >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ slot \in [Copies -> Patrons \cup {None}]
    /\ confirmed \in [Patrons -> SUBSET Copies]
    /\ inSwap \in [Copies -> Patrons \cup {None}]
    /\ seq \in [Copies -> 0..MaxSeq]

Init ==
    /\ slot = [cp \in Copies |-> None]
    /\ confirmed = [p \in Patrons |-> {}]
    /\ inSwap = [cp \in Copies |-> None]
    /\ seq = [cp \in Copies |-> 0]

\* A branch opens a compare-and-swap on a free copy with no swap already open.
BeginSwap(p, cp) ==
    /\ slot[cp] = None
    /\ inSwap[cp] = None
    /\ inSwap' = [inSwap EXCEPT ![cp] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED << slot, confirmed, seq >>

BeginSwapA(p, cp) == BeginSwap(p, cp)
BeginSwapB(p, cp) == BeginSwap(p, cp)

\* The open swap completes, reserving the copy and bumping its sequence.
CompleteSwap(p, cp) ==
    /\ inSwap[cp] = p
    /\ slot[cp] = None
    /\ slot' = [slot EXCEPT ![cp] = p]
    /\ seq' = [seq EXCEPT ![cp] = (@ + 1) % (MaxSeq + 1)]
    /\ inSwap' = [inSwap EXCEPT ![cp] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED confirmed

\* A patron confirms a reservation only on a copy whose slot names it.
Confirm(p, cp) ==
    /\ slot[cp] = p
    /\ cp \notin confirmed[p]
    /\ confirmed' = [confirmed EXCEPT ![p] = @ \cup {cp}]
    /\ UNCHANGED << slot, inSwap, seq >>

\* A swap aborts because the copy was taken in the meantime.
AbortSwap(cp) ==
    /\ inSwap[cp] # None
    /\ slot[cp] # None
    /\ inSwap' = [inSwap EXCEPT ![cp] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << slot, confirmed, seq >>

\* A patron releases a confirmed copy, clearing its slot and bumping its sequence.
Release(p, cp) ==
    /\ cp \in confirmed[p]
    /\ confirmed' = [confirmed EXCEPT ![p] = @ \ {cp}]
    /\ slot' = [slot EXCEPT ![cp] = None]
    /\ seq' = [seq EXCEPT ![cp] = (@ + 1) % (MaxSeq + 1)]
    /\ UNCHANGED inSwap

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, cp \in Copies : BeginSwapA(p, cp)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, cp \in Copies : BeginSwapB(p, cp)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, cp \in Copies : CompleteSwap(p, cp)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, cp \in Copies : Confirm(p, cp)
    \/ \E cp \in Copies : AbortSwap(cp)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons, cp \in Copies : Release(p, cp)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* A patron keeps a copy confirmed only while that copy's slot names it.
ConfirmedOwnsSlot ==
    \A p \in Patrons, cp \in Copies : cp \in confirmed[p] => slot[cp] = p

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Patrons = {p1, p2}
    Copies = {cp1, cp2}
    MaxSeq = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ConfirmedOwnsSlot
nl:
Scenario: a library book reservation system reserving copies by optimistic
locking with a per-copy compare-and-swap, where two branches share one copy pool.

Each physical copy has a reservation slot and a compare-and-swap sequence number.
Two branch servers reserve copies out of the same shared pool. To reserve a free
copy, a branch first opens a compare-and-swap on that copy (allowed only while the
copy is free and no swap is already in progress on it), then completes the swap:
the completion succeeds only while the copy is still free, at which point the copy's
slot is set to that patron and the sequence number is bumped. The patron then
confirms the reservation, but only on a copy whose slot names it, joining the copy
to its confirmed set. If by then the copy has been taken, the swap aborts.
Releasing a copy clears its slot and bumps its sequence.

Because a copy's reservation slot names a single patron, and a patron keeps a copy
in its confirmed set only while the slot names that patron, no copy is ever
reserved to two patrons at once.

Actions: branch one opens a compare-and-swap on a free copy (BeginSwapA); branch
two opens a compare-and-swap on a free copy from the shared pool (BeginSwapB); the
in-progress swap completes, reserving the copy and bumping its sequence
(CompleteSwap); a patron confirms a reservation on a copy whose slot names it
(Confirm); a swap aborts because the copy was taken (AbortSwap); a patron releases
a confirmed copy, clearing its slot (Release).

SAFETY PROPERTY: a patron keeps a copy in its confirmed set only while that copy's
reservation slot names the same patron, so no copy is reserved to two patrons at
once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od16m9p5t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Rx, MaxEpoch, MaxCap

ASSUME MaxEpoch \in Nat /\ MaxEpoch >= 1
ASSUME MaxCap \in Nat /\ MaxCap >= 1

VARIABLES
    authorized,  \* set of prescriptions currently authorized
    authEpoch,   \* authEpoch[x] = epoch x's authorization was stamped with
    filled,      \* set of prescriptions irreversibly filled
    epoch,       \* current formulary epoch
    capacity     \* current dispensing capacity (changes at runtime)

vars == << authorized, authEpoch, filled, epoch, capacity >>

TypeOK ==
    /\ authorized \subseteq Rx
    /\ authEpoch \in [Rx -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ filled \subseteq Rx
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ authorized = {}
    /\ authEpoch = [x \in Rx |-> 0]
    /\ filled = {}
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

\* Authorize an unfilled prescription, stamping the current epoch.
Authorize(x) ==
    /\ x \notin authorized
    /\ x \notin filled
    /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {x}
    /\ authEpoch' = [authEpoch EXCEPT ![x] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED << filled, epoch, capacity >>

\* Fill a freshly authorized prescription below capacity, consuming the auth.
Fill(x) ==
    /\ x \in authorized
    /\ authEpoch[x] = epoch
    /\ x \notin filled
    /\ Cardinality(filled) < capacity
    /\ filled' = filled \cup {x}
    /\ authorized' = authorized \ {x}
    /\ UNCHANGED << authEpoch, epoch, capacity >>

\* Reconfigure the formulary, bumping the epoch and staling authorizations.
Reconfigure ==
    /\ epoch' = (epoch + 1) % (MaxEpoch + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED << authorized, authEpoch, filled, capacity >>

\* Drop a stale authorization.
DropStale(x) ==
    /\ x \in authorized
    /\ authEpoch[x] # epoch
    /\ authorized' = authorized \ {x}
    /\ UNCHANGED << authEpoch, filled, epoch, capacity >>

\* Change the dispensing capacity at runtime.
CapacityChange(c) ==
    /\ c # capacity
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED << authorized, authEpoch, filled, epoch >>

Next ==
    \/ \E x \in Rx : Authorize(x)
    \/ \E x \in Rx : Fill(x)
    \/ Reconfigure
    \/ \E x \in Rx : DropStale(x)
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : CapacityChange(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No filled prescription is ever simultaneously authorized: the irreversible
\* fill of any prescription happens at most once.
FillOnce ==
    \A x \in Rx : x \in filled => x \notin authorized

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Rx = {rx1, rx2}
    MaxEpoch = 2
    MaxCap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FillOnce
nl:
Scenario: a pharmacy prescription dispenser that irreversibly fills controlled
prescriptions, governed by epoch-numbered reconfiguration, where dispensing
capacity changes at runtime.

Filling a controlled prescription is irreversible: once filled it stays filled for
good. A prescription must first be authorized before it can be filled, and each
authorization is stamped with the current formulary epoch. A prescription is filled
only from a fresh authorization -- one stamped with the current epoch -- and only
while the number filled is below the current dispensing capacity; filling consumes
the authorization. The formulary is reconfigured from time to time, bumping the
epoch and staling outstanding authorizations, which must then be dropped and
re-authorized. Dispensing capacity can also change at runtime.

A prescription can never be re-authorized once it is filled, and filling consumes
the authorization, so a filled prescription is never simultaneously authorized --
which means the irreversible fill of any prescription happens at most once.

Actions: authorize an unfilled prescription, stamping the current epoch (Authorize);
fill a freshly authorized prescription below capacity, consuming the authorization
(Fill); reconfigure the formulary, bumping the epoch and staling authorizations
(Reconfigure); drop a stale authorization (DropStale); change the dispensing
capacity (CapacityChange).

SAFETY PROPERTY: no filled prescription is ever simultaneously authorized, so the
irreversible fill of any prescription happens at most once.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od0m8p2t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Staff, Rooms, Total, Cap

ASSUME Total \in Nat /\ Total >= 1
ASSUME Cap \in Nat /\ Cap >= 1

None == "none"

VARIABLES
    loc,       \* loc[r] = number of patients in room r
    wardLock,  \* holder of the coarse ward lock, or None
    roomLock,  \* roomLock[r] = holder of room r's fine lock, or None
    crashed    \* set of staff who crashed (at most one)

vars == << loc, wardLock, roomLock, crashed >>

RECURSIVE SumLoc(_)
SumLoc(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET r == CHOOSE x \in S : TRUE IN loc[r] + SumLoc(S \ {r})

TypeOK ==
    /\ loc \in [Rooms -> 0..Total]
    /\ wardLock \in Staff \cup {None}
    /\ roomLock \in [Rooms -> Staff \cup {None}]
    /\ crashed \subseteq Staff

Init ==
    /\ loc = [r \in Rooms |-> IF r = CHOOSE x \in Rooms : TRUE THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ wardLock = None
    /\ roomLock = [r \in Rooms |-> None]
    /\ crashed = {}

AcquireWard(s) ==
    /\ s \notin crashed
    /\ wardLock = None
    /\ wardLock' = s
    /\ UNCHANGED << loc, roomLock, crashed >>

AcquireRoom(s, r) ==
    /\ wardLock = s
    /\ roomLock[r] = None
    /\ roomLock' = [roomLock EXCEPT ![r] = s]
    /\ UNCHANGED << loc, wardLock, crashed >>

\* The source-room-lock holder transfers one patient to a below-capacity room.
Transfer(s, r1, r2) ==
    /\ roomLock[r1] = s
    /\ r1 # r2
    /\ loc[r1] > 0
    /\ loc[r2] < Cap
    /\ loc' = [loc EXCEPT ![r1] = @ - 1, ![r2] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED << wardLock, roomLock, crashed >>

ReleaseRoom(s, r) ==
    /\ roomLock[r] = s
    /\ roomLock' = [roomLock EXCEPT ![r] = None]
    /\ UNCHANGED << loc, wardLock, crashed >>

ReleaseWard(s) ==
    /\ wardLock = s
    /\ \A r \in Rooms : roomLock[r] # s
    /\ wardLock' = None
    /\ UNCHANGED << loc, roomLock, crashed >>

\* A single staff member crashes silently, dropping its held locks.
Crash(s) ==
    /\ crashed = {}
    /\ crashed' = {s}
    /\ wardLock' = IF wardLock = s THEN None ELSE wardLock
    /\ roomLock' = [r \in Rooms |-> IF roomLock[r] = s THEN None ELSE roomLock[r]]
    /\ UNCHANGED loc

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Staff : AcquireWard(s)
    \/ \E s \in Staff, r \in Rooms : AcquireRoom(s, r)
    \/ \E s \in Staff, r1 \in Rooms, r2 \in Rooms : Transfer(s, r1, r2)
    \/ \E s \in Staff, r \in Rooms : ReleaseRoom(s, r)
    \/ \E s \in Staff : ReleaseWard(s)
    \/ \E s \in Staff : Crash(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Patients are conserved: the total across all rooms never changes.
Conservation ==
    SumLoc(Rooms) = Total

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Staff = {st1, st2}
    Rooms = {r1, r2}
    Total = 2
    Cap = 2
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
Scenario: a hospital operating-room scheduler moving patients between rooms under
hierarchical locks (a coarse ward lock, then fine per-room locks), where a single
staff member can crash silently.

A fixed number of patients is distributed across the rooms; patients are only ever
moved between rooms, never created or destroyed. To move a patient a staff member
must take locks in hierarchical order: first the single coarse ward lock, then the
fine lock on the source room. Holding the source room's lock, the staff member
transfers one patient to another room that is below its capacity. Fine room locks
are released before the coarse ward lock.

A single staff member may crash silently: it stops participating, and its held ward
and room locks are dropped so others can proceed. At most one staff member ever
crashes.

Because every transfer moves exactly one patient from one room to another, the
total patient count never changes.

Actions: grab the free ward lock (AcquireWard); the ward-lock holder locks a room
(AcquireRoom); the source-room-lock holder transfers one patient to a below-capacity
room (Transfer); release a room lock (ReleaseRoom); release the ward lock once
holding no room locks (ReleaseWard); a single staff member crashes silently,
dropping its locks (Crash).

SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of patients across all rooms always equals the
fixed starting count.
